description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P' which implements an experimental HTML5-based parser leveraging the PH5P library. It also contains classes 'HTML5' and 'HTML5TreeConstructer' that handle HTML5 tokenization, DOM tree construction, and error handling, integrating with PHP's DOMDocument for parsing and tree building. The code features methods for tokenizing HTML, handling different states, managing DOM nodes, and error recovery, indicating it is part of a custom HTML sanitizer or parser component within a larger project.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_PH5P
classes.description: An experimental HTML5 parser using the PH5P library that attempts tokenization with fallback to a DirectLex parser in case of DOM extension errors.

classes.name: HTML5
classes.description: A class that performs tokenization of HTML5 content, handling different states such as Data, TagOpen, EndTagOpen, etc., and managing entities, errors, and the creation of a DOM tree.

classes.name: HTML5TreeConstructer
classes.description: A class responsible for constructing a DOM tree from tokens, managing parser phases, element stack, and integration with PHP's DOMDocument.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Tokenizes HTML input into a series of tokens, normalizes and wraps the input, and attempts to parse with the HTML5 class.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Returns the serialized DOM structure built by the HTML5 parser.

methods.name: emitToken
methods.description: Emits a token to the tree constructor, managing content models and error states.

methods.name: entity
methods.description: Parses and decodes HTML entities encountered during tokenization.
